headline: Farranac and Lykos See Fresh Base Swaps; Attrition Rages
war_summary: Since the last edition the northern sectors of Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf have fallen silent — no ownership changes in the past two hours after each recorded two flips around 02:00 Z. In contrast, Farranac Coast logged a new capture at 04:10 Z, raising its six‑hour event count to three and keeping the day total at fifteen. Lykos Isle added two flips in the last six hours, the latest at 03:38 Z, pushing its day total to twenty‑four. The high‑casualty corridors continue to bleed: Weathered Expanse shows accelerating losses on both sides (≈ 780 colonial and 1 600 warden casualties per hour), Callahans Passage and Kings Cage both report rising wardens casualties, while Loch Mor, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow maintain steep but steady attrition with no further strategic‑base moves. Overall the map still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
